d:
A ghostly, floating Pokémon resembling a kimono-clad figure with a white, fluffy body and a long, flowing white garment. It has a small, pointed head with a singular, long, thin white horn and a small, reddish-pink mouth. It has no legs, instead tapering into a wispy, ethereal white tail. It possesses three fingered hands.
BODY COLOR: snowy white
